name: Maestro Desktop

product.summary: Central desktop local-first para planejar, executar e acompanhar agentes de IA em workspaces selecionados.
product.audience: Desenvolvedores que precisam coordenar agentes com segurança e transparência.

visualDirection.name: Focused operations console
principles: dense enough for professional agent operations without feeling like a monitoring wall
warm neutral surfaces with restrained indigo and cyan status accents
strong information hierarchy, quiet borders, and clear progressive disclosure
no decorative gradients, glassmorphism, or oversized marketing typography

accessibility.keyboard: All actions and panes operable by keyboard with visible focus rings
accessibility.status: Never communicate run state through color alone
accessibility.density: Primary controls remain at least 36px high and icon-only controls have accessible names

constraints: Desktop-first at 1024px and above, with graceful compact layout down to 800px
Use real data states: empty, loading, error, offline, awaiting approval, active, canceled, complete
Structured sessions and PTY sessions must remain visually distinct
Plan approval and destructive boundaries must be explicit
Do not expose chain-of-thought; show concise rationale and structured analysis only
